controls.label: 修改书名与封面
controls.inline: ()=>{if(document.querySelector('.edit-name'))return;const input=document.createElement('input');input.className='edit-name';input.maxLength=20;input.value=book.textContent;input.setAttribute('aria-label','回忆册名称');book.after(input);book.classList.add('hidden');input.focus();input.select();input.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')input.blur()};input.onblur=()=>{const name=input.value.trim()||'我们的夏天';book.textContent=name;document.querySelector('.cover-title').textContent=name;document.querySelector('.dialog-title').textContent=`确定删除《${name}》？`;localStorage.setItem('fairy-memory-book-name',name);book.classList.remove('hidden');input.remove()}}

controls.label: 归档回忆册
controls.inline: e=>{const archived=e.currentTarget.dataset.archived!=='true';e.currentTarget.dataset.archived=String(archived);e.currentTarget.textContent=archived?'取消归档回忆册':'归档回忆册';localStorage.setItem('fairy-memory-book-archived',String(archived))}
